title: Detects needlessly owned Cow types.
summary: The borrowed types are usually more flexible, in that e.g. a Cow<'_, str> can accept both &str and String while Cow<'_, String> can only accept &String and String. In particular, &str is more general, because it allows for string literals while &String can only be borrowed from a heap-owned String). Clippy puts this lint in the style group, at the level warn.
